Asturian

[edit]

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • IPA(key): /ˈaθido/ [ˈa.θi.ð̞o]
  • Rhymes: -aθido
  • Syllabification: á‧ci‧do

Adjective

[edit]

ácido

  1. neuter of ácidu

Galician

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin acidus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • IPA(key): /ˈaθido/ [ˈa.θi.ð̞ʊ]
  • IPA(key): (standard) /ˈaθido/ [ˈa.θi.ð̞ʊ]
  • IPA(key): (seseo) /ˈasido/ [ˈa.si.ð̞ʊ]

 
  • Rhymes: -aθido
  • Rhymes: -aθido
  • Rhymes: -asido

Adjective

[edit]

ácido (feminine ácida, masculine plural ácidos, feminine plural ácidas)

  1. acidic, acid
    Antonym: básico

Noun

[edit]

ácido m (plural ácidos)

  1. acid
    Antonym: básico

Derived terms

[edit]
  • ácido desoxirribonucleico
  • ácido nucleico
  • ácido ribonucleico

Further reading

[edit]
  • “ácido”, in Dicionario da Real Academia Galega (in Galician), A Coruña: Royal Galician Academy, 2012–2026
  • “ácido”, in Dicionário Estraviz de galego (in Galician), 2014–2026
  • Barreiro, Xavier Varela; Guinovart, Xavier Gómez (2006–2018), “ácido”, in Corpus Xelmírez: corpus lingüístico da Galicia medieval [Corpus Xelmírez: linguistic corpus of Medieval Galicia] (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
  • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, editor (2006–2013), “ácido”, in Dicionario de Dicionarios da lingua galega [Dictionary of Dictionaries of the Galician language] (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
  • Antón Luís Santamarina Fernández, Ernesto Xosé González Seoane, María Álvarez de la Granja, editors (2003–2018), “ácido”, in Tesouro informatizado da lingua galega (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega
  • Rosario Álvarez Blanco, editor (2014–2024), “ácido”, in Tesouro do léxico patrimonial galego e portugués (in Galician), Santiago de Compostela: Instituto da Lingua Galega, →ISSN

Portuguese

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Learned borrowing from Latin acidus.

Pronunciation

[edit]
 
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈa.si.du/
  • (Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈa.si.du/
    • (Southern Brazil) IPA(key): /ˈa.si.do/
  • (Portugal) IPA(key): /ˈa.si.du/ [ˈa.si.ðu]

  • Audio (Brazil (Caipira)):(file)
  • Hyphenation: á‧ci‧do

Noun

[edit]

ácido m (plural ácidos)

  1. (chemistry) acid (any of various substances which react with bases to form salts)
  2. (informal) acid (any corrosive liquid)
  3. (slang) clipping of ácido lisérgico; acid (LSD)

Coordinate terms

[edit]
  • base

Adjective

[edit]

ácido (feminine ácida, masculine plural ácidos, feminine plural ácidas)

  1. acid (very sour)
  2. (chemistry) acidic (relating to or being an acid)
  3. (figurative) unpleasant and/or sarcastic

Related terms

[edit]
  • azedo

Further reading

[edit]
  • “ácido”, in Dicionário Aulete Digital (in Portuguese), Rio de Janeiro: Lexikon Editora Digital, 2008–2026
  • “ácido”, in Dicionário inFormal (in Portuguese), 2006–2026
  • “ácido” in Dicionário Aberto based on Novo Diccionário da Língua Portuguesa de Cândido de Figueiredo, 1913
  • “ácido”, in Dicionário infopédia da Lingua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Porto: Porto Editora, 2003–2026
  • “ácido”, in Michaelis Dicionário Brasileiro da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), São Paulo: Editora Melhoramentos, 2015–2026, →ISBN
  • “ácido”, in Dicionário Priberam da Língua Portuguesa (in Portuguese), Lisbon: Priberam, 2008–2026

Spanish

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

    Learned borrowing from Latin acidus.

    Pronunciation

    [edit]
    • IPA(key): /ˈaθido/ [ˈa.θi.ð̞o] (Equatorial Guinea, Spain)
    • IPA(key): /ˈasido/ [ˈa.si.ð̞o] (Latin America, Philippines)
    • Audio (Colombia):(file)
    • Rhymes: -aθido (Equatorial Guinea, Spain)
    • Rhymes: -asido (Latin America, Philippines)
    • Syllabification: á‧ci‧do

    Adjective

    [edit]

    ácido (feminine ácida, masculine plural ácidos, feminine plural ácidas)

    1. sharp, tart
    2. acidic
    3. harsh

    Derived terms

    [edit]
    • ácidamente
    • acidez
    • antiácido
    • lluvia ácida

    Noun

    [edit]
    Spanish Wikipedia has an article on:
    ácido
    Wikipedia es

    ácido m (plural ácidos)

    1. (chemistry) acid
    2. (informal) acid, LSD

    Hyponyms

    [edit]
    • See also Category:es:Acids.

    Derived terms

    [edit]
    • acidemia
    • acidificar
    • acidimetría
    • acidímetro
    • acilo

    Related terms

    [edit]
    • acedía
    • acedo
    • acidosis
    • acídulo

    See also

    [edit]
    • agrio
